posts.text: CESC — Purvah Green Acquires 1.4 GWp ReNew Portfolio Deal Summary: 1.4 GWp operating solar & wind portfolio (6 SPVs across Rajasthan & Karnataka) from ReNew. Enterprise Value of INR 4,859 crore (~USD 509 mn); cash consideration of INR 1,582 crore at closing (includes equity and debt refinancing). SECI under 25-year PPAs; balance with Karnataka discoms. All assets operational. Tariff realizations (~Rs 2.5–3.0/kWh average for SECI solar portfolios). On an annualized basis, a portfolio of this scale is expected to incrementally add roughly INR 150–200 crore to consolidated PAT once fully integrat…
